question: Which of the following types of chisels is used for separating metals after chain drilling?
solution:
The correct answer is __Web chisel.__

**__Key Points__**

__
 
• Web chisel__ is specifically used for separating metals after chain drilling.
 
• It is designed to cut through the web or thin sections of metal.
 
• Web chisels are known for their precision and are effective in removing excess material after drilling.
 
• They play a vital role in engineering applications requiring intricate metalwork.

**__Additional Information__**

 
• **Flat Chisel:**

 
 
• Used for general-purpose metal cutting and shaping.
 
• It has a flat cutting edge suitable for flat surfaces.
 
 
 
• **Cross-cut Chisel:**
 
 
• Designed for cutting grooves and slots in metal surfaces.
 
• It has a narrow cutting edge for precision work.
 
 
 
• **Diamond Point Chisel:**
 
 
• Used for cutting sharp corners and intricate shapes.
 
• It has a pointed tip for detailed work.
